images.prompt: Edit the supplied pixel-art fantasy countryside background into an ADVENTURE gameplay variant for STARLIT-GUILD. Reference/edit target is the supplied tower-road image: preserve its warm daytime palette, crisp pixel clusters, elevated oblique RPG camera, medieval half-timbered farm buildings, golden wheat, fenced vegetable fields, green trees, and dirt road identity. Recompose the land so the WALKABLE DIRT ROAD is a broad, near-horizontal continuous band across the FULL image width from normalized y=0.42 through y=0.90; it must remain unblocked at both left and right edges. The road can curve gently toward the upper-right after this band. Place farm houses, crop fields, tall fences, stone walls and large trees ONLY above y=0.38, or in the very bottom 6 percent corners. Bottom foreground must mainly remain flat dirt with sparse small grass tufts, NOT foreground roof, wall, cliff or hedge. Camera looks downward at roughly 50 degrees, showing roofs and plentiful ground, no horizon or sky. Small architectural scale: a standing adult doorway opening at midground about 15 percent of total image height. Natural well-used wagon road with subtle wheel ruts and small pebbles, not an empty arena or huge courtyard. Do not add people, creatures, carts, text, labels, UI, separate panels or borders. One seamless finished landscape illustration, 1536x1024, opaque background. Keep stylistic pixel detail and local daylight geography from the reference; improve composition for a horizontal party traversal.

Keep a few small inconspicuous grass tufts near bottom corners, but no major obstacle below the open plaza. View downward at around 50 degrees, roofs visible at top edges, no sky.
